Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
Gen Con Indy is 2 weeks away. If you haven't purchased a badge, you
can do so on-site at the Indiana Convention Center starting Wednesday
, August 18th at 5 pm. With over 250 exhibitors including our
co-sponsors' Upper Deck Entertainment and Wizards of the Coast's
exciting displays in the colossal Exhibit Hall and over 4,700 gaming
event you don't miss the Best Four Days in Gaming in the Midwest! Make
sure and check out the following:

$1,000 "World Series of Gen Con" Poker Tournament Sponsored by
www.gamestation.net. Don’t miss out on four action-packed days of
poker at Gen Con Indy 2004!

Pre-registration is already strong for the tournament that will run
for all four days of the convention. Qualifiers for the finals will
start every evening of the convention at 8pm and are guaranteed to be
over by Midnight. The top 3 players each night will earn an automatic
spot into the finals to be held on Sunday morning, where the top prize
will be a new Gamestation 500 piece 11.5 gram poker chip set in
aluminum case, a copy of "DD Tournament Poker" by Eagle Games, a
trophy for their efforts, and $1,000!

If you have any questions, concerns, or comments about the tournament,
please visit us in the Gen Con Forums through the following link
http://forums.gencon.com/?f=21&m=18523

Full tournament rules and demos of No Limit Texas Hold ‘Em will take
place at the Gamestation Booth # 843 during exhibit hall hours. Come
on by and join in the fun!

Games Quarterly Magazine & Gen Con LLC Promote Hobby Gaming. At this
year's gigantic Gen Con Indy game convention, we will have thousands
of copies of the new issue #2 of Games Quarterly Magazine on hand,
free for attendees. This adds to our cooperation in sending a free
copy each quarter to a rotating 20,000 game enthusiasts on Gen Con's
mailing list.

Gen Con is running a feature article in GQM #2 on the 4,672 plus game
events planned for this year's Gen Con Indy. The article builds on the
attractiveness of attending the largest hobby game convention and
promotes some of Gen Con's biggest supporting companies. Games
Quarterly #2 ships this Friday. On Friday you can download a complete
copy from www.gamesquarterly.net or pick up a copy on-site from the
Star Wars Celebration III/ Gen Con So Cal booth located in the
concourse of the Indiana Convention Center.

For more information go to www.gencon.com!

--------------------------
--------------------------

GenCon 2k4 Roll Call

The Lasombra
